svg.aria-label: The Tavi Valley town hall: five people behind a long table with microphones, under a banner reading New Tavi mine: yes or no? Each has a speech bubble and a name plate: the mayor (chair), the Kestrel Mining CEO (yes), a fisher (no), a scientist (judge) and a youth climate leader (solve).
